question: At selected near-goal/pre-invalid saved states, distinguish local prediction-validity/ranking, fixed-cost/readiness mismatch and finite candidate-bank coverage without replacing frozen results.

selection.near_goal_rule: failed S1/SK active boundaries, elapsed<=29.2+1e-9 s, pos<=.015 m, abs pi-symmetric yaw<=9 deg; minimum squared normalized distance per stratum; ascending family_id/controller_id/tick tie-break
selection.pre_invalid_rule: all three learned terminal-unexecuted planner_invalid inputs; no replacement

restore.arbitrary_tick_method: initial fullsnapshot + original applied-command prefix; verify all available saved raw/witness/plan_index, store newly reconstructed full state
restore.missing_original_fullsnapshot_note: Do not claim unavailable original internal state was directly compared. Use exact original replay comparisons where available; never relax tolerances after outcomes.

panel_A.semantics: fixed nominal 5 commands, no future replanning or supervisor command replacement
panel_A.cost: original H5 nine-term cost with original previous actual command
panel_A.ready_after_first_hit: freeze first-hit verdict; continue physics to H5 for cost only; physical invalid still invalidates candidate
panel_A.terminal_status_policy: Never re-consume terminal TaskStatus; freeze official first hit and use separate nonterminal diagnostic hold tracker thereafter.

panel_B.semantics: committed nominal candidate with actual-pose zero supervisor, then three zero-command intervals; no model replanning
panel_B.zero_rule: For k<5, zero iff current actual boundary pose is in tolerance; otherwise nominal[k]. Not latched. For k>=5 always zero.
panel_B.A_vs_B_prefix: Compare first-ready by .5s. A_POST_READY_INVALID/B_ABSORBING_READY is termination-convention difference, not supervisor-command effect. Compare command intervention locally only with this distinction.

task.verdict: action boundary with continuous raw-substep hold

decision_rules.repeat_requirement: 3/3 validity and ready agreement; otherwise UNSTABLE_REPLAY and inconclusive
decision_rules.epsilon: 1e-6 + 1e-5*max_abs_finite_cost across only 3/3 actual-valid candidates; no such candidate => epsilon and ranking null / NO_VALID_ACTUAL
decision_rules.cost_interval: L_i=min repeats, U_i=max repeats for valid candidates
decision_rules.M1: predicted invalid but 3/3 actual_A valid, with same nominal commands and horizon
decision_rules.M2: model-selected actual_A invalid OR L_selected > U_alternative+epsilon; no-valid-prediction recorded separately, never regret=0
decision_rules.C: stable ready_A exists; every possible-cost-optimum candidate is non-ready; some non-ready U+epsilon < min ready L
decision_rules.C_unresolved: possible-optimum set mixes ready/non-ready or no ready_A or unstable actuals
decision_rules.I: A/B transition or ready differences; full B includes changed horizon, cannot attribute to model or cost alone
decision_rules.S: Base 128 complete and all stable non-ready or stable invalid, no UNSTABLE/MISSING; stable ready in one prespecified extra bank within same panel. A coverage additionally requires entire H5 physical validity.

conditional_extension.trigger: no ready in base state/panel AND all 128 complete with stable classifications, zero UNSTABLE/MISSING; else hold extension and S unresolved
conditional_extension.deduplication: retain original IDs and record duplicates; no replacement

stages.scope: F-O0 restore and original candidate identity check only
N-T/F-O0 candidate indices0..15 A/B x3; resources and fidelity pilot, absence of ready is not failure
case-level hypothesis report and separate next-intervention design

resource_limits.gate: measure pilot before D3 and D4; NOT_RUN_RESOURCE if over cap; no silent sample/model/repeat reduction
resource_limits.pilot_reuse_rule: Only exact driver/code/design/input/bank identity and accepted raw records may be reused as D3 rows; any repair requires new version and resource replan.
resource_limits.restoration_reuse_rule: Capture offset00 tick246 and254 in the same original-command replay; no planned duplicate prefix replay.
resource_limits.total_caps_include: restoration, pilot, primary, extension, inference, replay checks and all derived recording

failure_policy.infrastructure_or_restore_error: stop, preserve completed prefix; fix under a new version/run
failure_policy.scientific_failure: retain as result with denominator and reason

claims_not_supported: S1 versus SK superiority from selected snapshots
sole cause of original E2 failures
full MPC closed-loop reproduction from candidate-only panels
